brief:
Israeli military attacks killed 10 Palestinians on Wednesday across the Gaza Strip, according to IMEMC News citing hospital sources in the territory. Strikes struck Gaza City and the Nuseirat refugee camp, leaving multiple dead and many others wounded. Hospital staff reported receiving casualties from both locations as rescue and medical response efforts unfolded across the affected areas.

The deaths marked the latest toll in a series of ongoing Israeli military operations across Gaza. The hospital sources did not immediately provide further details on the circumstances of the individual strikes or the identities of those killed in the day's attacks.
